integrity_notes: The proof is self-contained aside from standard hyperbolic Witt extension and the explicitly cited toric ray-parabolic construction/splitting theorem. Self-review only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The Helly value and bundle threshold concern only maximal parabolics stabilizing distinct isotropic lines for split SO(2m) over complex numbers, m>=4.
Do not interpret as a determination of the unrestricted Helly number of type D_m.
The projective-space corollary concerns equivariant splitting and requires all ray parabolics of the stated form.
Finite exact checks do not verify infinitely many ranks or configurations.
The full texts of relevant Cooperstein partial-frame surveys/theorems were not accessible for full priority comparison.
title: Sharp line-parabolic Helly threshold in split even orthogonal groups
